## VSiN Stability Score — as printed

Steve Makinen's Stability Score (pp. 41–44), reproduced exactly. This library does not recompute it, re-weight it, or substitute a TTW score.

| Component | Points | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Head coach returns | 4 | Returning head coach |
| Offensive coordinator returns | 3 | Returning OC |
| Defensive coordinator returns | 3 | Returning DC |
| Quarterback returns | 0 | **New QB** |
| Returning starters | 2 | 12 returning starters as printed in the table |
| **Total** | **12** | 2025 record 8-5 |

> The guide's own use of this number: it plays on teams with a Stability Score edge of 6 or more in non-conference games in weeks 0–3, and against teams scoring 0–6 in the same window, excluding games with a spread of 30 or more (pp. 40–41).
